title: Design System: D+Dents Odontologia e Estética (Jardim Zaira)

display.purpose: The single H1 in the hero. Bricolage Grotesque 700, tight tracking, balanced wrap.

headline.purpose: H2 of every section. Bricolage Grotesque 600.

quote.purpose: The one large patient quote. Bricolage Grotesque 500.

title.purpose: Treatment group titles over a 1.5px ink rule; step titles are 1.3125rem.

lead.purpose: Hero sentence and section intros, muted, 38ch to 56ch.

label.purpose: Buttons and links, Hanken Grotesk 600, sentence case.

shadows.name: photo-lift
shadows.purpose: Hero photo, carousel images and map. Dark theme: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4), 0 18px 40px -16px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6).

shadows.name: gold-seat
shadows.purpose: Gold button at rest; hover deepens the drop to 0 14px 24px -12px rgb(20 42 33 / 0.6).

shadows.name: header-stuck
shadows.purpose: Header, only after scrolling past the top sentinel (plus a 12% white bottom border).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing curve; used for every transition and animation.

motion.name: hero-rise
motion.purpose: Hero copy children, one orchestrated entrance.

motion.name: hero-photo-reveal
motion.value: 1.2s clip-path inset(0 0 0 14%) to inset(0); image settles scale(1.06) to 1 over 1.6s

motion.name: scroll-reveal
motion.value: opacity 0.8s, transform 0.9s, translateY(20px) to 0, delay via --d (110ms steps)
motion.purpose: Section content as it enters the viewport; JS-gated with a 4s safety reveal.

motion.name: press
motion.value: hover translateY(-1px) over 0.25s; active translateY(1px) scale(0.985)

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animations and transitions 0.01ms; smooth scroll off
motion.purpose: Everything above runs only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

narrative.overview:
A visitor who is nervous about the dentist should be able to check, within one scroll, that this clinic is real and kind: the actual storefront with its street number, the 5,0 rating from 391 Google reviews, the clinic's own before/after photos, patients describing fear turning into trust. The design carries that thesis by staying out of the way of the evidence. Forest-green bars hold the real logo (a light logo that needs a dark green ground), a pale cool-green paper holds the content, and a single warm gold marks the one action on the page: schedule an evaluation on WhatsApp.

The mood is calm, local and grown-up rather than clinical. Type is large and friendly-tight (Bricolage Grotesque headlines, Hanken Grotesk text), shapes are soft (16px on every image and surface, pill buttons), and the page is nearly flat: depth comes from tonal bands (paper, white, sage, forest) and one soft shadow under photographs. Dark mode follows the visitor's system and swaps the paper for a green-black while keeping the same gold.

The world is recognizable with no content: a forest-green logo bar, a gold pill, a wide storefront photo held inside the page margins with rounded corners. The system rejects the dental-landing default (teal and white, stock smiles, three icon cards in a row); it is not an icon-card page, and photographs are always the clinic's own.
keyCharacteristics: Two brand colors only: forest green (structure, bars, headings of authority) and gold (action, stars on dark, small signals).
Green-tinted neutrals; no pure grey, no pure black on the light theme.
Pill buttons, 16px surfaces and images, hairline rules instead of boxes.
Nearly flat: tonal bands for sectioning, one soft shadow on photos and map, a lifted shadow only on the gold button.
Real evidence first: photo, rating, results, quotes, address, map.
One orchestrated entrance on the hero, calm scroll reveals elsewhere, all gated by reduced-motion.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold is the call to action and nothing else decorative. Filled gold means "schedule on WhatsApp"; the label is the same ("Agendar avaliação") everywhere. Gold may also appear as a small supporting mark (link underline, nav underline, icons on green, selection), never as a section background or a second button color.

rules.name: The Logo Ground Rule
rules.body: The light logo only ever sits on Forest Bar. Anything that holds the logo, or closes the page (header, closing block, footer), uses the forest bands; content bands use paper, surface or sage.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral leans green (hue about 146 to 167). No #000, no #fff text, no cool grey.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, buttons and headings are written as normal sentences. Hierarchy comes from size, weight and the display face, not from uppercase, letterspacing or small tracked captions above headings.

rules.name: The Short Measure Rule
rules.body: Prose never runs wider than about 38ch (lead), 44ch (descriptions) or 56 to 60ch (supporting text). Headlines and quotes use `text-wrap: balance`, paragraphs use `pretty`.

rules.name: The Flat Until Raised Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows belong to photographs, the gold button, the stuck header and the floating button; text containers, quotes and list rows never get a shadow or a box.

dos: **Do** use Forest Bar (#1e3a2f) for anything that holds the logo or closes the page, and keep the light logo on it unchanged.
**Do** keep gold (#c9a84c) to the schedule action and small supporting marks, with On Gold (#142a21) text on it; keep the label "Agendar avaliação" identical on every gold button.
**Do** use 16px radius on every image and surface, and full pills (999px) on every button and icon button.
**Do** keep controls at 48px (large 54px) and any tap target at 44px or more.
**Do** put photographs and the rating first; rely on the clinic's own images, keep the hero photo inside the page margins, and keep the 16/9 crop.
**Do** tint neutrals toward green and flip them with `prefers-color-scheme: dark` by editing only the tokens in `:root`.
**Do** gate decorative motion behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` and use the single ease-out curve.
**Do** use `text-wrap: balance` on headings and quotes and keep prose under about 60ch.
donts: **Don't** fall back to the dental-landing default: teal and white, stock smiles, a row of three icon cards.
**Don't** introduce a second accent color, gradients, or gold as a section background.
**Don't** wrap content in bordered, shadowed cards; use hairlines, tonal bands and whitespace.
**Don't** use uppercase, tracked captions or "eyebrow" labels above headings; the system does not have them.
**Don't** use stock or generated photographs, redraw or recolor the logo, or invent facts, prices or offers.
**Don't** put the light logo on a light ground, or put body text in pure black or pure white.
**Don't** animate layout properties or add motion that runs without the reduced-motion gate.
